```{r setup, echo=F, include=F}
# Setup ------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list = ls())
# Reference source codes & other dependencies:
source("DataTeam_ipmh.R")
source("Dependencies.R")
source("data_import.R")

#Read Quantitative data
quant_demographic_df <- aim1quant_df %>% 
    select(record_id, collect_time, women_dob_uk, women_dob, women_age,
           hcw_dob_uk, hcw_dob, hcw_age, hcw_sex,
           demographics_perinatal_women_complete,
           demographic_hcws_complete)

# Read Qualitative demographic data
qual_demographic_df <- aim1qual_demo_df

```


```{r Quant age range, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## HCW age range
hcw_demo <- quant_demographic_df %>%
    select(record_id, collect_time,
           hcw_dob_uk, hcw_dob, hcw_age, hcw_sex,
           demographic_hcws_complete) %>% 
  filter(demographic_hcws_complete =="Complete")

hcw_demo <- hcw_demo %>% 
     mutate(
    collect_time = ymd_hm(collect_time),
    hcw_dob = ymd(hcw_dob),
    age = case_when(
      hcw_dob_uk == "Yes" ~ floor(time_length(interval(hcw_dob, collect_time), "years")),
      hcw_dob_uk == "No"  ~ as.numeric(hcw_age),
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

hcw_quant_age_df <- hcw_demo %>% 
    select(record_id, age, hcw_sex) %>% 
    mutate(age_range = case_when(
       age >= 18 & age <=25 ~ "18-25",
       age >= 26 & age <= 45 ~ "26-45",
       age >= 46 & age <= 64 ~ "46-64",
       age >= 65 & age <= 75 ~ "65-75",
       age >75 ~ "> 76+"))

hcw_quant_age_summary <- hcw_quant_age_df %>% 
    group_by(age_range) %>% 
    rename(`Age Categories` = age_range ) %>% 
    summarise(Total = n())

## PPW age range
ppw_demo <- quant_demographic_df %>%
  select(record_id, collect_time, women_dob_uk, women_dob,women_age, demographics_perinatal_women_complete) %>%
  filter(demographics_perinatal_women_complete == "Complete")

ppw_quant_df <- ppw_demo %>%
     mutate(
     collect_time = parse_date_time(
      collect_time,
      orders = c("ymd HM", "ymd HMS")
    ),
    women_dob = ymd(women_dob),
    age = case_when(
      grepl("^Yes", women_dob_uk) ~ floor(time_length(interval(women_dob, collect_time), "years")),
      grepl("^No",  women_dob_uk) ~ as.numeric(women_age),
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

ppw_quant_df <- ppw_quant_df %>% 
    select(record_id, age) %>% 
    mutate(age_range = case_when(
        age >=14 & age<=17 ~ "14-17",
        age >= 18 & age <=25 ~ "18-25",
        age >= 26 & age <= 45 ~ "26-45",
        age >= 46 & age <= 64 ~ "46-64",
        age >= 65 & age <= 75 ~ "65-75",
        age >75 ~ "> 76+"))

## Filter those <18 Yrs
minors <- ppw_quant_df %>% 
    filter(age < 18)

ppw_quant_age_summary <- ppw_quant_df %>% 
    group_by(age_range) %>% 
    rename(`Age Categories` = age_range ) %>% 
    summarise(Total = n())
```


```{r Qual age range, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
qual_age_df <- qual_demographic_df %>% 
    select(record_id, hcw_age, policy_age, women_age, hcw_sex, policy_sex) %>% 
  mutate(age = coalesce(hcw_age, policy_age, women_age),
         Gender = coalesce(hcw_sex, policy_sex)) %>% 
  mutate(Gender = ifelse(is.na(Gender), "Female", Gender)) %>% 
    mutate(age_range = case_when(
       age >= 18 & age <=25 ~ "18-25",
       age >= 26 & age <= 45 ~ "26-45",
       age >= 46 & age <= 64 ~ "46-64",
       age >= 65 & age <= 75 ~ "65-75",
       age >75 ~ "> 76+")) %>% 
    select(record_id, age, Gender, age_range)

qual_age_summary <- qual_age_df %>% 
    group_by(age_range) %>% 
    rename(`Age Categories` = age_range ) %>% 
    summarise(Total = n())
```


```{r PPW RCT age range, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
ppw_rct_age <- ppw_rct_df %>% 
        mutate(
            visit_type = case_when(
                grepl("Enrollment", redcap_event_name) ~ "Enrollment",
                grepl("6 Weeks", redcap_event_name) ~ "6 Weeks",
                grepl("14 Weeks", redcap_event_name) ~ "14 Weeks", 
                grepl("6 Months", redcap_event_name) ~ "6 Months",
                TRUE ~ NA_character_
            )) %>% 
    filter(visit_type == "Enrollment") %>%
    group_by(record_id) %>%
    slice_head(n = 1) %>%   # keep only the Enrollment row per record_id
    ungroup() %>% 
    select(clt_ptid,clt_date,dem_dob_uk, dem_dob, dem_age)%>% 
    mutate(dem_age = if_else(
        dem_dob_uk == "Yes",
        floor(time_length(interval(dem_dob, clt_date), "years")),
        dem_age),
        Gender = "Female") %>% 
    mutate(age_range = case_when(
        dem_age >= 14 & dem_age <= 17 ~ "14-17",
        dem_age >= 18 & dem_age <=25 ~ "18-25",
        dem_age >= 26 & dem_age <= 45 ~ "26-45",
        dem_age >= 46 & dem_age <= 64 ~ "46-64",
        dem_age >= 65 & dem_age <= 75 ~ "65-75",
        dem_age >75 ~ "> 76+")) %>%
    select(clt_ptid, Gender, dem_age,  age_range) %>% 
    filter(!is.na(age_range))


rct_age_summary <- ppw_rct_age %>% 
    group_by(age_range) %>% 
    rename(`Age Categories` = age_range ) %>% 
    summarise(Total = n())
```


## Enrollment Summary

A total of `r qual_demographic_df$record_id %>% unique() %>% length()` have been enrolled in Qualitaive Survey, `r quant_demographic_df$record_id %>% unique() %>% length()` in Quantitaive Survey and `r ppw_rct_age$clt_ptid %>% unique() %>% length()` in Perinatal Women RCT.


### Enrollment Age Groups

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Merge summaries and compute totals
merged_summary <- hcw_quant_age_summary %>%
  full_join(ppw_quant_age_summary, by = "Age Categories") %>%
  full_join(qual_age_summary, by = "Age Categories") %>%
  full_join(rct_age_summary, by = "Age Categories") %>%
  mutate(`Total Count` = coalesce(Total.x, 0) +
                         coalesce(Total.y, 0) +
                         coalesce(Total.x.x, 0) +
                         coalesce(Total.y.y, 0)) %>%
  select(`Age Categories`, `Total Count`)

# Add grand total row
merged_summary <- merged_summary %>%
  bind_rows(
    tibble(`Age Categories` = "TOTAL",
           `Total Count` = sum(merged_summary$`Total Count`, na.rm = TRUE))
  )

# Render with gt
overall_table <- merged_summary %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Enrollment Age Report") %>%
  fmt_number(columns = vars(`Total Count`), decimals = 0) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold")),
    locations = cells_body(rows = `Age Categories` == "TOTAL")
  )

overall_table

```


```{r Gender and Age, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
qual_gender <- qual_age_df %>% 
    select(Gender, age) %>% 
    rename(Age = age) %>% 
    mutate(Gender = recode(Gender,
                        "1" = "Male",
                        "2"= "Female"))

hcw_quant_gender <- hcw_quant_age_df %>% 
    select(hcw_sex, age) %>% 
    rename(Age = age, Gender = hcw_sex) %>% 
    mutate(Gender = recode(Gender,
                        "1" = "Male",
                        "2"= "Female"))

ppw_quant_gender <- ppw_quant_df %>% 
    select(age) %>% 
    rename(Age = age) %>% 
    mutate(Gender = "Female")

ppw_rct_gender <- ppw_rct_age %>% 
    select(Gender, dem_age) %>% 
    rename(Age = dem_age)

enro_gender <- rbind(qual_gender, hcw_quant_gender, 
                     ppw_quant_gender, ppw_rct_gender)

write_xlsx(enro_gender, paste0("Enrollment Gender and Age", Sys.Date(), ".xlsx"))
```


```{r gender_summary, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Add study labels
qual_gender2 <- qual_gender %>% mutate(Study = "Qualitative")
hcw_quant_gender2 <- hcw_quant_gender %>% mutate(Study = "Quantitative")
ppw_quant_gender2 <- ppw_quant_gender %>% mutate(Study = "Quantitative")
ppw_rct_gender2 <- ppw_rct_gender %>% mutate(Study = "PPW RCT")

# Combine all datasets
all_gender <- bind_rows(
  qual_gender2,
  hcw_quant_gender2,
  ppw_quant_gender2,
  ppw_rct_gender2
) %>%
  mutate(Gender = toupper(Gender))   # Capitalize gender

# Summarize counts by Study and Gender, pivot to wide format
gender_summary <- all_gender %>%
  count(Study, Gender) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Study, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(Total = Qualitative + Quantitative + `PPW RCT`)

# Add grand total row
grand_total <- gender_summary %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum)) %>%
  mutate(Gender = "TOTAL")

gender_summary <- bind_rows(gender_summary, grand_total)

# Render with gt
gender_tbl <- gender_summary %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Gender Counts by Study Type") %>%
  fmt_number(columns = where(is.numeric), decimals = 0)

gender_tbl
```
